book.name: Epesa
book.title: Epesa Pâlaŋ Epesa am nâmkiŋpepeŋinmak ekŋengat zapat meluwaŋ kapi kumindaye

content: Nemba mambipmane ekŋengalen zapat
Animbi nemba in Amobotnaŋ Zisas egat mti mambiwine ekŋengalen zet gawepuwep. Mama mimi kaboŋ kapiyaŋ dolakŋaŋ penaŋ bein.
Zii zelen zet ŋen pigok tazin,

content.text: “Geŋ mambipdine egegat nâmane mobotnaŋ beme zemsesewatidewanik.” Zet kapiyaŋ zii zet mobotnaŋ penaŋ bein ma zet keyet zetik pigok zempepeŋaŋ tazin, (Kisim Bek 20:12)
“Nemba ŋenaŋ kegok mbe beme egaŋ msalen nukŋaŋ ŋen titipiŋ kan teepmaŋ penaŋ mamambe.” (Zii Zet 5:16)

content: Âpme nemba mambiwine in nembaŋineyaŋ kwileki ŋen myuŋgume nâmbekambemti ŋenzinziŋ mti nemba ekŋen keŋin mme bekanaŋ ku bewe. In ekŋen indikdamuŋ dolakŋaŋ mimindamti Amobotnaŋgalen zet zapat dolakŋanen zet tazin ke zemzikat indawep.
Msalengatnaŋ amobotnaŋmak sisiliŋ an ekŋengalen zet zapat

Sisiliŋ an in damuŋine ekŋengat nâme mobotnaŋ penaŋ beme kandaŋinan meti ekŋengalen zet gawepumti muluwin esemteŋ mti mambep. Kilaisiyet nâme mobotnaŋ beme zetnaŋ gawepumti egat kandaŋan mamaip sepem kegogak
in amobotnaŋine ekŋenaŋ indikme dolakŋaŋ bembeyet belak etaŋ segaŋ mulup mimindawepgat. In Kilaisiyelen mulup anene kegok mamti Kawawaŋaŋ mama mimi nâmtikŋaŋ mamin keboŋ keboŋ ke mâti mbep.
Wa am ekŋenaŋ nâmindeme mobotnaŋ bembeyet nâmti yek. Amobotnaŋ Zisas egaŋ nâmindeme mobotgat nâmti muluwin oloŋen palen mbep.
In nâit, am ŋenaŋ mulup dolakŋaŋ mti mambe beme Amobotnaŋaŋ dopmaŋ sepem kegogak sawe. Sisiliŋ an ma an lala manup bepi mulupmnaŋgat dopmaŋ sepem kwep kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ mimndawe.

Âpme an damuŋ, in kegogak sisiliŋ nembaŋine weyaŋ indadamuŋ mbep. In ekŋen zemtalat indemti ku mtot indewep in pigok nâmbep. Sisiliŋ an ma an damuŋ nin Amobotnaŋin kwewetaŋ kululuŋen tazin. Egaŋ an mobotnaŋ ma sisiliŋ an sambe nin bepi zet mulup sepem kwewetaŋ ndeme tabanup.
Nâmkiŋpepemak ekŋenaŋ kasa kuku an ekŋen keboŋ tabep
Neŋ zetn delaŋ zenzeŋaŋ kapigok zemdelaŋ zesâwapgat nâit. In Amobotnaŋmagen wetekumti tapme egalen windeŋaŋ temaŋ keyaŋ indapbulupme gweŋ gweŋ kumti tabep.
Mti Kawawaŋmagengatnaŋ timbisok ma moe ke timti tatnepeme Sadaŋaŋ buzakeset kasa timkwapme winde timti gweŋ gweŋ kum tabep.

Nâit, wa nin am ekŋenmak kasa ku maânup. Nin kasa Sadaŋgalen amobotnaŋ temaŋ temaŋ ma an ŋeŋaŋ temaŋ temaŋ ma maŋgeŋane bekanaŋ penaŋ windeŋinbeŋ mamaip nin zikalaŋ ŋep ku maindiknup ekŋen bekemak maâm bekambenup ekŋenaŋ msat kapi damuŋ mti mama mimi bekanaŋaŋ sambe sokbembeyet mulupmaŋ mamip.
Keyepmti in Kawawaŋmagengatnaŋ kasayelen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ ke timti weyaŋ tabep. Keyepmti kasa kuku kanen katikŋaŋ bemti tapme kasa ekŋenaŋ indom walesâgât mbewaŋ olapme beme belak katim indemti mebep.
In kapigok mti tabep, Kawawaŋgalen zet penaŋaŋ bitiminok zampemti mama teŋ mama keyaŋ melakandundu kapaŋinok beme suwalolo mbep.
Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ sewak mamayelen zet keyaŋ sewawatnok beme weti ime kwiŋ kume ektitipeŋ mambep.
Naman ŋotekŋaŋ temaŋ nâmkiŋpepeyaŋ moeŋinok beme mimwatonzemtapme an bekanaŋ Sadaŋ egalen namsamek kukŋaŋ keyaŋ kot keyet palen imti kukŋaŋ etumti tobe.

Kawawaŋaŋ yomengatnan gilik zemti ndatimti mama kanzizitgat zapat ndaye nânâ keyaŋ sipakandak bunduŋnok ŋokŋinan peme toti ŋokŋin aŋgalaŋ tabe. Âpme Kawawaŋgalen Zet sambe Emetak Teŋaŋ manzemâtâtindain keyaŋ wanam ŋilikŋaŋ keboŋ mti Sadaŋmak an âwep.
Emetak Teŋgalen windeen in Amobotnaŋgat mene mene dundum sapeŋ mamambep. Mti kandati mamapiŋ posiŋin mpeŋ tabep. Mti Kawawaŋgalen animbi notnaŋ ekŋengat otnâmti dundundu mulup mbep.
Mti nâgât kegogak dundume Amobotnaŋaŋ dembusekŋ mim eleŋ beleŋ beme neŋ kiŋgagapiŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ enzililiŋan tazin kapi eleŋ beleŋ bemti windennbeŋ ammagen zemkawaŋ bemebap.

Neŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ ke zemkawaŋ bema keyepmti mka katikŋan tot newien. Keyet in neŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ ke kiŋgagapiŋ tusumti mka katikŋan pien eyo zemkawaŋ bembeyet dundunduyaŋ bandim mnewep.
Zetn delaŋ zenzeŋaŋ

Tikikas ek nâmkiŋpepemak notn dolakŋaŋ penaŋ ek Amobotnaŋgalen mulup an dolakŋaŋ penaŋ keyepmti neŋ ek ke pema koti egaŋ neŋ mka katikŋan pien sepem zigok mamayap keyet yaŋaŋ ma msat kapi am nâmkiŋpepemak ekŋen sepem zigok mamaip keyet yaŋaŋ zemâtâtindame nâmti keŋin dukŋaŋ beme oloŋen mbep.
Kawawaŋ Bipm ma Amobotnaŋŋ Zisas Kilaismagen notnne, in egaŋ keŋ sewakŋaŋ mimindemti nâmkiŋpepeŋin mkatik bemindeme gogotmak mambep.
Am Amobotnaŋ Zisas Kilais gogot penaŋ mpemti mamaip am ekŋen ke Kawawaŋaŋ keŋ taolet mimindamti manepeme met mama kanzizit ke titiyet nâmti mandunduyap.
